settings_form.title: Mail
settings_form.description: How outgoing mail is sent and the SMTP account it uses.

backend.label: Delivery method
backend.help: How mail is delivered. Console sends nothing and only logs the messages (the body only in development and testing).

smtp_port.label: SMTP port
smtp_port.help: Port of the SMTP server, usually 587 or 465.

smtp_username.label: SMTP username
smtp_username.help: Account name for the SMTP server. Leave blank if it needs no sign-in.

smtp_password.label: SMTP password
smtp_password.help: Password for that account. It is hidden once saved.

smtp_from.label: Sender address
smtp_from.help: Address that appears as the sender of outgoing mail.

smtp_tls.label: Use TLS
smtp_tls.help: Encrypt the connection to the SMTP server.

smtp_tls_mode.label: TLS mode
smtp_tls_mode.help: Auto uses implicit TLS on port 465 and STARTTLS elsewhere. Or force one mode on any port. Ignored when TLS is off.
